description: Browser agent capability assessment for multi-tenant SaaS application

tasks.name: Sign In and Reach Dashboard
tasks.description: Authenticate with test credentials and verify dashboard access

tasks.name: Navigate to Cases
tasks.description: Access the case management page via sidebar navigation

tasks.name: Create Case
tasks.description: Create a new case with title and description

tasks.name: Re-open Created Case After Refresh
tasks.description: Verify case persists and can be reopened after page refresh

tasks.name: Upload PDF
tasks.description: Upload a PDF document via file picker

tasks.name: Upload CSV
tasks.description: Upload a CSV document via file picker

tasks.name: Find Matching Audit Log Entry
tasks.description: Navigate to audit log and verify case creation was logged

tasks.name: Seed Scenario
tasks.description: Use admin seed to create sample data

tasks.name: Reset Seeded Data Safely
tasks.description: Remove only seeded data while preserving other data

tasks.name: Recover from Invalid Org Slug
tasks.description: Handle invalid org slug gracefully and recover

tasks.name: Create New Shipment
tasks.description: Navigate to Logistics, fill out the new shipment form with carrier, service type, addresses, and create a shipment

tasks.name: Find Shipment by Tracking Number
tasks.description: Navigate to Logistics shipment list and locate a specific seeded shipment using the carrier filter

tasks.name: Update Shipment Status to Delivered
tasks.description: Open a booked shipment and update its status to 'delivered'

tasks.name: Download Invoice from Shipment Detail
tasks.description: Navigate to a delivered shipment and download its invoice

tasks.name: Filter Shipments by Carrier and Count
tasks.description: Filter the shipment list by carrier 'ups' and verify the count in the table header

assertions: All visible rows have UPS badge

tasks.name: Navigate Pagination on Shipment List
tasks.description: Verify pagination controls work when more than 15 shipments exist (seed multiple runs if needed)

steps.expected_state: Second page loaded or pagination absent

assertions: Page number updated or all items on one page

pass_criteria: Pagination works correctly if multiple pages exist

tasks.name: Find All Pending Orders Across Channels
tasks.description: Navigate to Marketplace orders, filter by status 'pending', count total pending orders

tasks.name: Update Order Status to Shipped
tasks.description: Find a pending Amazon order and update its status to shipped using the inline status dropdown in the orders table

tasks.name: Change Listing Price
tasks.description: Navigate to Marketplace listings, find an active listing, and update its price

steps.expected_state: Edit mode activated, price field editable

tasks.name: Download Orders CSV Report
tasks.description: Navigate to Marketplace reports and generate a live orders CSV for Amazon

assertions: Generate Live Orders Report section visible

tasks.name: Filter Orders by Date Range
tasks.description: Apply a date range filter on the orders page to find orders from a specific period

assertions: Visible orders fall within date range

tasks.name: Find Listings with Low Stock
tasks.description: Navigate to listings, identify products with stock below threshold (indicated by warning icon)

assertions: Warning icon (⚠) present on low-stock rows

pass_criteria: Low stock count captured from banner

tasks.name: Find Employee by Department
tasks.description: Navigate to HR Portal, filter employees by the Engineering department, and count results

assertions: All visible employees are in Engineering department

tasks.name: Create Sick Note Submission (Multi-Step Wizard)
tasks.description: Complete the 4-step HR submission wizard to create a sick note for an employee
pass_criteria: Detail page loads with correct data

tasks.name: Submit a Draft Submission
tasks.description: Find a seeded draft submission in the HR portal and submit it to trigger status transition

tasks.name: Check Reference Number of Approved Submission
tasks.description: Find an approved HR submission and record its reference number

assertions: At least one approved submission visible

tasks.name: Navigate to Employee Detail from Submission
tasks.description: From a submission detail page, navigate to the linked employee record via the employee name link

tasks.name: Filter Submissions by Kurzarbeit Type and Count
tasks.description: Filter HR submissions by type 'Kurzarbeit' and count the number of results

tasks.name: Navigate to Reconciliation Dashboard
tasks.description: Navigate to the reconciliation module and verify the dashboard loads with summary stats

assertions: Summary cards visible (Pending, Matched, Flagged, Total)

tasks.name: Find a Flagged Invoice
tasks.description: After seeding, navigate to Reconciliation, filter invoices by 'flagged' status, and open the first flagged invoice

assertions: At least one flagged invoice visible

tasks.name: Match an Invoice to an Expected Amount
tasks.description: Find a pending invoice, fill the expected amount, select match type 'exact', and confirm the match

tasks.name: Flag a Discrepancy with a Reason
tasks.description: Find a pending invoice and flag it with reason 'Duplicate invoice detected'

tasks.name: View Reconciliation Report and Export CSV
tasks.description: Navigate to the Reconciliation Reports page and trigger the CSV export

tasks.name: Navigate to Tender Desk
tasks.description: Navigate to the Tender Desk portal and verify the tender list loads

assertions: Status filter and Type filter present

tasks.name: Filter Tenders by Status Open and Count
tasks.description: Apply status filter 'open' on the Tender Desk and capture the total count of open tenders

assertions: All visible rows have 'open' status badge

tasks.name: Find Tenders Closing Soon
tasks.description: Filter tenders by status 'closing_soon' and verify at least one result with a highlighted deadline

assertions: At least one row with 'closing soon' badge visible
Deadline column shows a date with days-remaining indicator

pass_criteria: Closing soon tenders visible with deadline urgency indicator

tasks.name: Filter Tenders by Type Restricted
tasks.description: Apply both status filter 'all' and type filter 'restricted', then count the results

assertions: All visible rows have 'restricted' type badge

tasks.name: Open Tender Detail and Read Estimated Value
tasks.description: Open the first tender in the list, navigate to its detail page, and record the estimated value shown

tasks.name: Navigate to Tender Submissions List
tasks.description: From the Tender Desk, follow the 'View all submissions' link and verify the submissions list loads

tasks.name: Navigate to Tax and Disclosure Dashboard
tasks.description: Navigate to the Tax & Disclosure portal and verify the dashboard renders with summary cards

tasks.name: Read Upcoming Deadline Count from Tax Dashboard
tasks.description: Read the number in the 'Upcoming Deadlines' summary card on the Tax dashboard

assertions: 'Due within 30 days' label visible below the count

tasks.name: Filter Tax Filings by Draft Status
tasks.description: Navigate to the Tax Filings list, apply status filter 'draft', and count the results

assertions: Table with Reference, Type, Period, Status columns present
All visible rows show 'draft' status badge

tasks.name: Open Tax Filing Detail and Read Filing Reference
tasks.description: From the Tax Filings list, open the first filing and capture its filing reference number

assertions: Filing reference visible (format like ELG-XXXX or similar)

tasks.name: Navigate to Disclosures List
tasks.description: From the Tax dashboard, navigate to the Disclosures subpage and verify the list loads

assertions: Table with Reference, Title, Status columns present

tasks.name: Find a Published Disclosure
tasks.description: Navigate to Disclosures, apply status filter 'published', open the first result, and verify the publication date

assertions: At least one disclosure with 'published' badge visible

tasks.name: Filter Customs Declarations by Exception Status
tasks.description: Navigate to the Customs portal, apply the 'exception' status filter, verify declarations with exception status appear, and open the first result

assertions: At least one declaration with 'exception' badge visible
Other status badges no longer visible

tasks.name: Create New Customs Export Declaration
tasks.description: Navigate to the new customs declaration wizard and complete all 4 steps to create an export declaration: select type, fill routing, enter goods details, enter parties, then submit

steps.expected_state: New declaration wizard loaded, step 1 of 4

assertions: Origin DE and destination US visible

steps.expected_state: Declaration created, redirected to detail page

tasks.name: Upload Supporting Document to Declaration
tasks.description: Navigate to a customs declaration with exception status, upload a PDF document using the file upload control, and verify the document appears in the documents list

assertions: Documents section shows at least 3 entries
Uploaded file name visible in documents list

tasks.name: Update Declaration Status to Under Review
tasks.description: Navigate to a submitted customs declaration, change the status to 'under_review' using the status dropdown, and verify the badge updates

tasks.name: Resolve a Customs Exception
tasks.description: Navigate to the Customs exception queue, filter for open exceptions, and resolve the first open exception using the Resolve button

assertions: At least one open exception visible
Resolve button present on first row
Or exception disappears from open filter view
